title: Native graphical manipulation corrections
summary: Correct Windows acceptance failures in semantic flow selection, drag/reorder and nested reparenting while preserving the accepted workspace appearance.
criteria: Reproduce and correct supported flow drag/reorder and nested reparenting; cover actual pointer/drop behavior, empty destinations, zoom and cancellation with regression tests.
Preserve validated model transactions, undo/redo and persistence; verify exact-head hosted CI and independent review.
Generate a corrected Windows installer and retest the failed interactions at the parent RUST-04 acceptance gate.

history.summary: Registered correction scope after owner reported two failures on native Windows build a707bf5; eight other checks including visual fidelity passed.
